{{Top|leg}}
'''Articles of Withdrawal''' were submitted by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] member worlds who wished to leave the Republic.

Following [[Nil Spaar]]'s criticism of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] to the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] just prior to the [[Yevethan Purge]], [[Tig Peramis]], [[Hodidiji]], and three other hereditary rulers representing their worlds in the Senate submitted Articles of Withdrawal.
